title: Running a Business Online
tagline: Social media marketing and selling online.
description: Whether you sell tomatoes, chitenge or phone repairs, learn to show your products online, talk to customers, and take payments safely.
outcomes: Take clear photos of your products

lessons.title: Setting up a business profile
lessons.body:
WhatsApp Business and a Facebook page let customers find you and see your products.

## What to add
Your business name, what you sell, where you are, opening hours and your phone number. Use a clear photo as your profile picture.
key_points: Customers need your name, location and hours
Use WhatsApp Business for your shop
lessons.try_it: Write down the five details you would put on your business profile.

lessons.title: Taking good product photos
lessons.body:
Good photos sell more. You do not need an expensive phone.

## Tips
Take photos in daylight near a window or outside. Use a plain background like a wall or cloth. Clean the camera lens with a soft cloth. Show the price clearly in your post.
lessons.try_it: Take three photos of one product using these tips.

lessons.title: Taking payments safely
lessons.body:
Customers will want to pay with mobile money.

## Protect yourself
Only release goods after you check your real balance, not after seeing an SMS. Keep a simple record of each sale: date, item, amount, customer.
key_points: Check your balance before handing over goods
Keep a record of every sale
lessons.try_it: Start a simple sales notebook or phone note today.

quiz.question: When should you hand over goods paid by mobile money?
options: When the customer says they paid
quiz.explanation: SMS can be faked. Your real balance is the only proof.

quiz.question: What makes a good product photo?
quiz.explanation: Daylight and a plain background show your product clearly.
